info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Operations Status API
info.description: The Credit Risk Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the status of credit risk operations within the wholesale trading environment. This API enables users to monitor and assess the performance of credit risk activities, ensuring that financial services operate efficiently and transparently. Typical consumers include risk management teams, compliance officers, and trading analysts who rely on up-to-date information to make informed decisions. Accessing this API allows stakeholders to verify operation statuses and respond proactively to any potential issues.

get.summary: Retrieve the credit risk operation status.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of credit risk operations in the wholesale trading context. It provides insights into ongoing processes and can aid in decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to query the current status of credit risk operations in wholesale trading. It should contain the necessary parameters as specified in the schema to retrieve the appropriate status details.
